quotes.text: Modernization isn't a rebuild, It's an upgrade in how you inter act with what you already have. Your lists, libraries, and store data still serve as the core.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes SharePoint modernization as an incremental upgrade instead of a costly rebuild.

quotes.text: Power apps can generate a canvas app from a SharePoint list quickly. You don't need to port your data or write back end code. The canvas app points directly to the list as its data source.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains concretely why turning a list into an app needs no data migration.

quotes.text: Automated cloud flows replace those brittle chains with something visible, auditible, and predictable. Instead of hiding logic deep in an old template, flows use clear triggers and actions you can see
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Contrasts legacy workflows with cloud flows in one clear argument.

quotes.text: When you replace manual tagging with automated extraction, your document libraries stop feeling like cluttered caverns. They become organized vaults, each new file sorted, labeled, and ready to trigger the next step in a workflow.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarizes the business value of AI Builder document processing.

quotes.text: Copilot Studio lets you build chat based assistance that can connect to your SharePoint data, power automate flows and apps so you can query data and trigger actions conversationally.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Defines what Copilot Studio adds on top of SharePoint in one sentence.

takeaways: SharePoint 2010 workflows are already retired and SharePoint 2013 workflows face full retirement in SharePoint Online, so inventory classic workflows and InfoPath forms now.
Power Apps can generate a canvas app directly on top of an existing SharePoint list, and Power Automate cloud flows replace brittle legacy approvals with visible, auditable automation.
AI Builder's classify and extract models turn document libraries into searchable metadata, and Copilot Studio lets users query SharePoint data and trigger actions in natural language.
hook: Legacy SharePoint 2010 and 2013 workflows and InfoPath forms are being retired, yet many organizations still depend on them. This episode is for SharePoint admins and Power Platform makers who need a practical modernization path. You learn how Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder and Copilot Studio upgrade your existing lists and libraries without starting from scratch.
